# Pinned, own-engine-only subset; see README.md for changes and attribution.
add_library(trp_framewarp_options INTERFACE)
target_compile_features(trp_framewarp_options INTERFACE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(trp_framewarp_options INTERFACE /W4 /permissive- /EHsc /utf-8 /MP)
target_compile_definitions(trp_framewarp_options INTERFACE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE FW_VERSION="1.9.1-trp-native-experiment")
target_include_directories(trp_framewarp_options INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
add_library(trp_framewarp_core STATIC src/presenter/renderer.cpp src/presenter/latewarp12.cpp)
target_link_libraries(trp_framewarp_core PUBLIC trp_framewarp_options d3d12 dxgi dcomp d3dcompiler advapi32 shlwapi shell32 ole32)
add_executable(TRPFrameWarpPresenter WIN32 src/presenter/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(TRPFrameWarpPresenter PRIVATE trp_framewarp_core user32 pdh xinput)
set_target_properties(TRPFrameWarpPresenter PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/$<CONFIG>/FrameWarp")
if(TRP_BUILD_COMPATIBILITY_TESTS)
    foreach(kind pose motion estimator)
        add_executable(TRPFrameWarp${kind}Tests tests/${kind}_tests.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(TRPFrameWarp${kind}Tests PRIVATE trp_framewarp_options)
        add_test(NAME FrameWarp_${kind} COMMAND TRPFrameWarp${kind}Tests)
        set_tests_properties(FrameWarp_${kind} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
    endforeach()
endif()
